findings.message: The slice `rows[start : start + size + 1]` returns `size + 1` users per page, so every page is one item too long and repeats the first user of the next page. The old `LIMIT ? OFFSET ?` query returned exactly `size` rows.
findings.suggestion: return [User(r["id"], r["email"], r["name"]) for r in rows[start : start + size]]

findings.message: The query now fetches the whole `users` table into memory on every page request and slices it in Python. Memory use and latency then grow with the table size instead of the page size. Keep `LIMIT ? OFFSET ?` with parameters so SQLite returns only the requested page.
